newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURK DOGAN GROUP BUYS 50.5 PCT OF CELIK HALAT.
newsitem.headline: TURK DOGAN GROUP BUYS 50.5 PCT OF CELIK HALAT.

text.p: Turkish media and finance group Dogan Sirketler Grubu Holding AS bought 50.53 percent of steel rope producer Celik Halat ve Tel Sanayi AS for $21.05 million, officials said on Friday.

The 50.53 percent Celik Halat stake was put on sale earlier this year by sequestration and bankruptcy authorities after owner AOG Turkinvest brokerage house went bankrupt during the 1994 financial and economic crisis.
The authorities announced Dogan group as the winner of the tender for the sale of the Celik Halat stake after local Karamanci Holding, a second bidder, failed to show up for the final negotiations.
They said a due diligence investigation in Celik Halat would be carried out before the sale procedure is completed within a month.
If Celik Halat's value comes out more than two percent below the sale price at the end of the investigation, the difference will be deducted from the sale price.
Celik Halat will hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting for changes in management after the completion of the sale.

The Istanbul stock exchange briefly halted trade in Celik Halat shares in the afternoon to receive the tender results. Company shares traded at 5,600 lira in mid-afternoon trade, up from 5,150 at Thursday's close.
Dogan Holding shares stood at 4,500 lira, up from 4,400 lira at Thursday's close.
Celik Halat, Turkey's leading steel wire and rope targets a six trillion lira turnover this year after 2.9 trillion lira in 1996.
